info.name: Provincial LGU Governance Platform API - CARAGA
info.description:
Complete API collection for Provincial LGU Governance Intelligence Platform - CARAGA Region (Region XIII)

**Total Endpoints:** 146+
**Authentication:** Laravel Sanctum (Token-based)
**Updated:** 2026-01-30

**Default Login:**
- Username: admin
- Password: Password123!

**Base URL:** http://localhost:8000/api

**How to Use:**
1. Send a POST request to `/api/login` with your credentials
2. The token will be automatically saved to `{{access_token}}` variable
3. All authenticated requests will use this token automatically via Bearer authentication
4. Use `/api/logout` to invalidate your current token

**New Features:**
- **LGU Multi-Sector Governance (RA 7160)** - SS, ES, IEM, GPS sector management and filtering
- Password reset and change endpoints
- 10 Critical Government Compliance Metrics (COA/DBM/NEDA)
- Project Team Member Management
- Project Milestone Tracking
- Progress Report Image Management
- Storage Statistics
- Sector-based filtering across all project and dashboard endpoints

**Note:** All authenticated endpoints require a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
